continuous.command: lightbench tps 128 5 (warmup), then lightbench spikes 2 10 (2 edits/20 ticks for 200 ticks), then lightbench tps sweep 5
continuous.metric: Main server tick duration excludes async worker CPU; post-run drain separately recorded
continuous.validation: Initial/full final light; independent roof replay; capped cases excluded

generation.metric: Provision, deferred light completion and explicit finalization; output hashing outside timing
generation.qualification: Requirematching scoredterrain/light hashes for equal-output speed ranking

blocks.metric: setBlockState through stored server light completion, update flags16
blocks.geometry: Uniform floorY3; glowstone atY4; no roof
blocks.validation: Per-edit probes plus independent full Sky/Block volume before/after measurement

memory: Atleast100post-workload ticks then explicit GC; wholegame heap and2second sampled process working set, not engine-only memory

travel.qualification: Server readiness, not client mesh completion; complete terrain hash after timing

sky.geometry: 64x64 stone roofY254 over floorY3; 250-block-tall stress columns

limitations: Within-run timing can drift despite extended warmup; inspect time series and report run ranges. Drift alone does not prove its cause is JIT.
Normal generation pilot differs in terrain by one brown mushroom and differs in light hashes; do not promote those times as same-output speed ratios.
No external publishing/push/tag is authorized; prepare reviewable local assets and text.
label: Pulsar 0.5.0
graphics: 1280x720, render distance4, VSync off, maxFPS260 means unlimited
frames: Render callback intervals, not presented FPS; client loaded-chunk counts differ, so no equal-scene FPS speedup claim
statistics: Median of4 independent JVM run means; min-max range, notconfidence intervals. Do not pool all samples as independent JVM repetitions.
